_doc: Region generation rules (ADR-014, D2/D5) + the E1b world data (docs/content/regions.md — the ELEVEN regions). Each region declares a WFC tile palette + adjacency (organic biome fill), an optional SimpleDungeons set-piece spec (authored rooms stitched on top), and a hand-authored fallback grid used when the solver fails (no soft-lock). Tile ids are small ints into a per-region palette; -1 is void. Forces/biomes mirror docs/Mutants_Game_World.md + docs/content/regions.md (8 force-regions + the Threshold hub + the Maw Beneath + the Hollow Atelier).
_tiles: 0=ground/floor, 1=feature-a (water/lava/crystal/etc per region), 2=feature-b/path, 3=wall/edge. Renderer maps ids to a region tileset; meaning is the renderer's concern.
_travel: E1b Threshold network fields, read by RegionCatalog: title (display name), blurb_key (VoiceBook entry sting), tier_band (the wild-pool tier span, mirrored by tools/gen_region_pools.py), gate_flag (run.flags story gate — empty = always open; verdant + threshold are always open), gate_hint (the locked-row copy on the travel overlay). Gate flags are the E1a quest-catalog act gates (tools/INGEST_NOTES.md): registered_aspirant is the hand-wired Act-0 climax flag (the act1_open alias), act<N>_open is set by quest (N-1).4's completion. Wild/elite/boss pools live in catalog/region_pools.json (generated) except verdant_glut (catalog/slice_verdant.json stays the verdant source).
